title: Иборасозӣ 24: Рӯзҳои корӣ, сафар ва табиат

words.ex: We travel to the village in summer.
I visit my grandmother every week.
She writes a letter to her friend.
My father reads a book in the evening.
I open the window in the morning.
She closes the door and goes to bed.
We buy bread and milk from the shop.
The farmer sells vegetables at the market.
My mother goes to the market.
The shop is near our house.
I need money to buy a book.
The price of bread is good.
The water is free in the café.

instruction: 📓 ҲАТМАН! Ҳамаи луғат, матн ва ибораҳоро дар дафтар нависед! Бе навиштан дар хотир намемонад.
